units.source_text: 本地有一个俗语说：“光阴似箭”，一晃又过去一年。

en.t: There is a local saying, “time flies like an arrow,” and in the blink of an eye another year had passed.

units.source_text: 某一天，此地突然遭逢大火，长崎市一夜之间化为焦土。

en.t: One day, a great fire suddenly struck the place, and Nagasaki was reduced to scorched earth overnight.

units.source_text: 景象无比惨烈，就像听到裁判最后的号角，

en.t: The sight was unspeakably horrific, as if one were hearing the final trumpet of judgment,

units.source_text: 声音冲破烈火，响彻天际，令人闻风丧胆。

en.t: its sound breaking through the flames and ringing across the sky, terrifying all who heard it.

units.source_text: 当时，伞翁加正当在下风扣，

en.t: At that time, San'onga happened to be on the downwind side,

units.source_text: 父母俩狼狈抛出屋外，仓皇间却忽然找不到幼儿，

en.t: and the parents had stumbled out of the house in panic, only to realize in the confusion that they could not find their little child,

units.source_text: 应该是忘在屋里了。

en.t: who must have been left inside the house.

units.source_text: 伞翁顿时嚎啕，

en.t: San'onga immediately broke into loud sobs,

units.source_text: 如果不是众人拦着女子，女子就奋身跑进火场了。

en.t: and if the others had not held the woman back, she would have thrown herself into the fire.

units.source_text: 但是风越来越大，火也越来越大，

en.t: But the wind kept growing stronger, and the fire kept growing larger,

units.source_text: 烈焰轰鸣，好似连天山繁星一起吞没。

en.t: while the roaring flames seemed ready to swallow the sky, the mountains, and the stars all together.

units.source_text: 众多救火的人乱作一团，

en.t: The many people trying to fight the fire fell into complete disorder,

units.source_text: 除了阻拦要进火场的近乎疯狂的女子，也都束手无策。

en.t: and apart from restraining the nearly mad woman who wanted to rush into the flames, none of them could do anything.

units.source_text: 这个时候，有一个人，推开众人，冲到现场，

en.t: At that moment, one man pushed through the crowd and rushed to the scene,

units.source_text: 这个人就是西美昂。

en.t: and that man was Simeon.

units.source_text: 这个不畏生死的彪形大汉，

en.t: This huge, powerfully built man who feared neither life nor death

units.source_text: 略微观察了下形势，便冲进火场，

en.t: took a brief look at the situation and then charged into the fire,

units.source_text: 但是火势越来越猛烈，浓烟滚滚扑面，

en.t: but the flames grew fiercer and fiercer, and thick smoke billowed into his face,

units.source_text: 他数次冲进浓烟又退了回来。

en.t: so several times he plunged into the smoke and then retreated again.

units.source_text: 于是只能走到伞翁和女子前面说：

en.t: At last he could only go before San'onga and the woman and say,

units.source_text: “这件事只能祈求主的安排，

en.t: “In this matter, we can only pray for the Lord’s will,

units.source_text: 不是人力可以阻止的了。”

en.t: for it is no longer something human strength can stop.”

units.source_text: 这个时候伞翁身后忽然有人大喊：

en.t: Just then, someone suddenly shouted from behind San'onga,

units.source_text: “天主啊，祈求保护。”

en.t: “O Lord, I beg You for protection.”

units.source_text: 声音很是熟悉，西美昂转身发现，

en.t: The voice was very familiar, and when Simeon turned around, he saw

units.source_text: 那不就是罗连嘛。

en.t: that it was none other than Loren.

units.source_text: 火光照着他清瘦的脸庞，

en.t: The firelight shone on his thin, delicate face,

units.source_text: 大风使他的及肩黑发飞扬，

en.t: and the strong wind sent his shoulder-length black hair flying,

units.source_text: 眉目清丽，一眼就能认出他来，

en.t: his features were clear and graceful, and one could recognize him at a glance,

units.source_text: 罗连像乞丐一样，站在众人面前，

en.t: as Loren stood before the crowd like a beggar,

units.source_text: 眼睛一眨不眨，目光炯炯的望着大火种的家宅。

en.t: without blinking, staring with shining eyes at the house within the great fire.

units.source_text: 忽然，一阵狂风袭来，

en.t: Suddenly, a violent gust of wind swept in,

units.source_text: 他一跃向前，

en.t: and he sprang forward,

units.source_text: 在火柱、火壁、火梁的间隙疾奔而入。

en.t: racing in through the gaps between pillars of fire, walls of fire, and beams of flame.

units.source_text: 西美昂大惊失色，

en.t: Simeon was shocked and turned pale,

units.source_text: 急切的望着天空频频在胸前划着十字祷告：

en.t: then looked anxiously up at the sky and repeatedly made the sign of the cross over his chest as he prayed,

units.source_text: “主啊，请赐福。”

en.t: “Lord, please grant Your blessing.”

units.source_text: 不知道为什么，

en.t: For reasons he could not understand,

units.source_text: 此时他眼前出现的竟然是罗连在瑟瑟寒风中来开圣鲁卡教堂的时候，

en.t: what appeared before his eyes at that moment was Loren, in the bitter cold wind, coming to Saint Luke’s Church,

units.source_text: 夕阳余晖中他的背影优雅而萧条。

en.t: his figure from behind elegant yet desolate in the lingering glow of the sunset.
